event.reason: At pinned repository revisions, 205 English FineWeb, 135 French FineWeb2, and 146 Spanish FineWeb2 Parquet files were enumerated with path, Git oid, LFS SHA-256, byte size, xet hash and last commit. All 486 entries are unique within language, have valid immutable LFS identities and positive sizes, and show zero cross-language LFS overlap; payload bytes downloaded were zero. The overall training gate remains HOLD until deterministic hash-ranked row sampling, matched per-language training budgets, and confirmation-corpus decontamination are frozen and validated.
